chosenApproach: Main-only app version 1.3.5/versionCode 29 with explicit runtime 1.3.2. Add strict ABI-equivalence gate that ignores ONLY version/versionCode while rejecting any native config or native dependency drift. Create isolated GitHub Action on exact merged main commit to invoke EAS production AAB once and verify its signed build metadata and URL. No Expo OTA or web deploy.
selectionRationale: VersionCode must rise for Google Play; versionName is human-facing and may become 1.3.5 independently of update runtime. Preserving compatible runtime allows V28 and V29 to consume the same verified production JS OTA; a false jump to runtime 1.3.5 would strand the existing OTA channel unless a new runtime OTA is published.
alternativeApproaches: Change runtime to 1.3.5 when only store metadata changed—rejected because V28-compatible native ABI remains unchanged and would split OTA audience needlessly.
Rebuild from legacy frozen native workflow's V21 source—rejected because it would lose all consolidated changes and carry stale branding.
Build V29 on current production source with isolated one-time release pipeline, exact-main guard and AAB verification—selected.
